entities.summary: Aleksej Pokuševski is a Serbian professional basketball player and the vice-captain for Partizan Belgrade of the Basketball League of Serbia (KLS), the ABA League and the EuroLeague. Standing at 7 ft 0 in (2.13 m) and weighing 210 pounds (95 kg), he plays at the power forward position.
